stories.title: The Community Garden
stories.summary: A group of diverse neighbors decides to transform an empty lot into a vibrant community garden. They face small challenges like choosing the right plants and sharing tools, but learn to work together. The garden eventually thrives, bringing fresh produce and new friendships to the neighborhood.

stories.title: The Lost Parrot
stories.summary: A young boy's pet parrot flies away from his window. He uses a new neighborhood app to ask for help finding it. Many people join the search, and the parrot is eventually found in a tall tree.
grammar_points: ではありませんでした(dewa arimasen deshita)

stories.title: Baking Dreams
stories.summary: A young woman loves baking delicious cookies in her small kitchen. She decides to start selling them online to her community. She learns to take beautiful photos of her cookies and package them carefully for delivery.

stories.title: Park Heroes
stories.summary: The local park has become messy with a lot of litter. A group of friends organizes a special cleanup day for the whole neighborhood. Many people come together to help, making the park clean and beautiful again.
grammar_points: ではありませんでした(dewa arimasen deshita)

stories.title: First Train Ride
stories.summary: A girl takes her very first train ride to visit her grandparents in another town. She sees many new and interesting sights outside the window. She learns how to read her ticket and find her seat on the big train.

stories.title: The Wobbly Shelf
stories.summary: A man tries to build a new wooden bookshelf for his growing collection of books. He follows the instructions carefully, but the finished shelf is very wobbly. His kind neighbor helps him fix it properly, and they both share a good laugh.
